title: Break in the interview; Paris, 26 February 1982
summary: Collier notes the date and place of the recording and resumes with the question of how Briggs reached Berlin.

blocks.x: You do have to leave Monday, huh?
Yes, I have to leave on Sunday.
Okay, this is February 26th, just after lunch, 1982, at Arthur Briggs apartment in the 18th Arrondissement in Paris.
And we were talking about when Arthur had gone to Vienna and then when you came back to Paris after the Vienna situation, how did you get to Berlin. That's an interesting point.
Yes, we talked about Vienna. We did the Vienna situation, yeh.
